At the prestigious 2026 Asia Yachting Awards held at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, Fantastic Vacation was honoured as Asia's Best Yacht Service Provider of the Year, standing out among 86 nominated enterprises from 12 countries. The award recognises the company's outstanding achievements in yacht customisation, charter operations, and exclusive membership services over the past year. Organised jointly by the Asia Yachting Industry Association (AYIA) and Asia Boating magazine, the award is widely regarded as the most authoritative and influential industry accolade in the Asia-Pacific yachting sector.

During the award ceremony, Fantastic Vacation Founder and CEO Hanson Lin delivered a keynote address, sharing the brand's philosophy of 'centering on the client, with the ocean as our radius.' He noted that over the past three years, Fantastic Vacation has served over 320 high-net-worth clients, grown its managed fleet from 15 to 52 yachts, and logged a cumulative annual cruising distance exceeding 1.2 million nautical miles across 36 major waters worldwide. 'This award is not only recognition of our team's dedication but also a testament to the vibrant growth of China's yachting industry,' Lin stated in his address.

The selection process was overseen by Deloitte as the independent auditor, with a jury comprising 15 senior industry experts from Monaco, Italy, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and mainland China. Candidates were evaluated across five dimensions: client satisfaction, service innovation, market share growth, safety management, and sustainability. Fantastic Vacation achieved a remarkable score of 98.6 in client satisfaction -- the highest in the category -- and earned high praise from the jury for its Smart Yacht Butler System and fully digital end-to-end service platform. AYIA Chairman Zhang Mingyuan remarked, 'Fantastic Vacation is redefining the standard for yacht services in Asia.'

On 10 May 2026, Fantastic Vacation Industrial Co., Ltd. officially inaugurated its new Global Headquarters at Shenzhen's Shekou Prince Bay, Nanshan District. The state-of-the-art facility represents a total investment exceeding RMB 380 million and spans 12,000 square metres, integrating a brand exhibition centre, client experience centre, global operations command centre, R&D hub, and modern office spaces. The headquarters will serve as the central nerve centre coordinating Fantastic Vacation's worldwide operations. Senior executives from 12 international partners -- including Ferretti Group (Italy), Feadship (Netherlands), and Lloyd's Register (UK) -- attended the grand opening ceremony.

The Global Operations Command Centre is equipped with a 24/7 real-time monitoring system capable of simultaneously tracking the real-time position, cruising status, and equipment telemetry of all 52 managed yachts across 36 waters worldwide -- enabling end-to-end digital management from route scheduling to safety alerts. The brand exhibition centre, spanning over 800 square metres, showcases scale models of Fantastic Vacation's four flagship families -- the Sovereign, Expedition, Flybridge, and Day Cruiser series -- along with an immersive VR yacht-viewing system that offers visiting clients a truly immersive vessel-selection experience.

Chief Operating Officer Jessica Chen stated at the ceremony that the Shenzhen headquarters marks the beginning of 'Global Strategy 2.0.' Over the next three years, Fantastic Vacation plans to establish regional offices in Singapore, Dubai, London, and Miami, building a global service network spanning five continents. The newly established yacht technology R&D centre within the headquarters will focus on cutting-edge fields including new-energy propulsion systems, intelligent onboard IoT, and AI-assisted navigation, with plans to file 8-12 core patents within the next 18 months. Representatives from the Nanshan District Government welcomed Fantastic Vacation's presence, highlighting the high-end yachting industry as a key component of Shenzhen's maritime economy.

The 33rd Monaco Yacht Show, held from 22-25 September 2026 at the legendary Port Hercule, attracted over 680 exhibitors from 67 countries and showcased 125 superyachts -- with more than 35% making their world debut. According to figures released by the organising committee, total signed superyacht orders during the four-day event surpassed EUR 3.5 billion, an 18% increase over the 2024 edition and an all-time record -- reflecting the enduring enthusiasm among UHNW individuals worldwide for the pinnacle of maritime luxury living.

As the flagship representative of China's yachting industry, Fantastic Vacation was invited to exhibit for the fifth consecutive year. Occupying Stand A3 in the main exhibition hall, the company's presence was themed 'Eastern Luxury, Global Discovery,' using immersive spatial design to showcase its comprehensive service capabilities to an international audience. During the show, Fantastic Vacation successfully secured contracts for three superyachts totalling over EUR 120 million: a 68-metre Sovereign-series flagship custom project commissioned by a Southeast Asian family office; a 52-metre Expedition-series explorer yacht with polar-navigation certification and helipad; and a 45-metre Flybridge-series full hybrid luxury yacht equipped with the latest-generation Torqeedo deep-sea electric propulsion system.

Additionally, Fantastic Vacation signed a strategic membership agreement with the Yacht Club de Monaco, becoming the first Greater China-based yacht service provider to join the prestigious club. International Business Director Alexandre Dubois commented, 'The Monaco Yacht Show is the global barometer for the superyacht market. Fantastic Vacation's consistent success here over five years is compelling proof of the international competitiveness and brand appeal of Chinese yacht companies. We are confident in growing our European business to 25% of total revenue by 2027.'

The 2026 Global Yacht Market Annual Report, published by leading research firm Global Marine Insights, reveals that the worldwide yacht market reached USD 32.8 billion in the 2025-2026 period, representing year-on-year growth of 11.2%. The most striking trend is the explosive growth of new-energy yachts: orders for hybrid and fully electric models surged by 42% year-on-year, with the segment exceeding USD 5 billion for the first time. The report identifies the approaching IMO 2030 emissions regulations, the EU Green Deal, and rising environmental consciousness among yacht owners as the primary growth catalysts.

Technologically, the report examines three dominant new-energy propulsion solutions. Diesel-electric hybrid systems command 62% of the market, primarily serving 30-50-metre mid-size luxury yachts, with Azimut's 'Hybrid Tech' platform and Feadship's 'Green Motion' system as leading examples. Pure lithium-battery electric systems account for 24%, led by Germany's Torqeedo and Norway's Devold, predominantly in the 12-25-metre day-cruiser and sailing yacht segment. Hydrogen fuel-cell systems represent 14% and remain in the early commercialisation phase, though Rolls-Royce MTU and Toyota Marine have each announced production-grade hydrogen power modules scheduled for 2027.

The report also highlights the Asia-Pacific region as the fastest-growing market for new-energy yachts. Combined orders from China, Singapore, and Australia grew 67% -- far outpacing Europe's 28% and North America's 19%. As an industry pioneer, Fantastic Vacation launched its 'Zero-Carbon Voyaging Initiative' in 2025, committing to raise the new-energy coverage of its managed fleet to over 60% by 2030. To date, the company has delivered six hybrid yachts, with four pure-electric custom projects currently under construction. CTO Dr. Marco Rossi notes, 'New energy is not merely about regulatory compliance -- it is an upgrade in client experience. The silence and elegance of an electric yacht gliding into a bay at sunset is something a traditional diesel engine simply cannot match.'

On 15 April 2026, Fantastic Vacation Industrial Co., Ltd. and Italy's Ferretti Group formally signed a comprehensive strategic partnership agreement in Milan. Under the agreement, Fantastic Vacation becomes the exclusive authorised dealer for Ferretti Group across Greater China -- mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan -- representing five flagship brands: Azimut, Ferretti Yachts, Pershing, Riva, and Custom Line, covering the full product range from 12 to 33 metres.

The signing ceremony took place at the historic Four Seasons Hotel Milano on Piazza del Duomo. Ferretti Group CEO Alberto Galassi and Fantastic Vacation Founder Hanson Lin jointly signed the agreement. Mr. Galassi commented, 'China is one of the most promising yacht markets globally. Fantastic Vacation's 15 years of deep industry experience, a client base of over 200 high-net-worth individuals, and a nationwide after-sales network make them our ideal partner for entering Greater China.' First-year sales targets are set at RMB 1.8 billion, with projections reaching RMB 3 billion by 2028.

Beyond sales, the partnership encompasses deep collaboration in product customisation, technical training, and after-sales service. Fantastic Vacation will establish a Ferretti Brand Asia-Pacific Experience Centre at its Shenzhen headquarters, featuring VR yacht selection, 1:1 scale model showrooms, and a dedicated sea-trial berth. Technical teams will undergo regular training at Ferretti's Forli headquarters in Italy to ensure Greater China clients receive the same standard of technical support as their European counterparts. The two parties also explored the possibility of a co-branded limited-edition series blending Eastern aesthetics with Italian craftsmanship, with the first three hulls slated for delivery in 2028.

Celebrating life's most special moments against a backdrop of sapphire seas and open skies has become one of the most coveted party experiences among the world's high-net-worth individuals. Sophie Chen, Fantastic Vacation's Director of Event Planning, brings over 12 years of experience orchestrating more than 200 themed maritime events for clients from eight countries. In her view, a flawless yacht birthday party requires systematic planning across five dimensions: venue selection, theme design, catering, entertainment, and safety. 'The magic of a yacht party lies in its uniqueness -- you never have to worry about your venue being replicated, because the ocean itself is the most luxurious backdrop,' Sophie shares.

Venue selection is the first and most critical step. For intimate gatherings of 10-20 guests, a 45-60-metre Flybridge luxury yacht is ideal -- the spacious flybridge deck accommodates cocktail receptions, while the main-deck salon serves for formal dinners. For parties exceeding 30 guests, an 85-metre-plus superyacht or a combination with a dedicated tender for water activities is recommended. Timing-wise, Sophie advises scheduling the party's peak two hours before sunset: anchoring in a picturesque bay as golden light bathes the ocean, with guests raising their glasses on the flybridge -- a scene that no land-based venue can rival.

For catering, Fantastic Vacation partners with Michelin-starred chefs to offer a range of options from French fine dining to Mediterranean seafood buffets. A sample 20-guest sunset dinner menu might include Australian Wagyu with black truffle jus, Boston lobster salad, chilled white wine with fresh oysters, and a bespoke birthday cake -- one client famously requested a 32-centimetre miniature sailing yacht integrated into the cake design, becoming the centrepiece of the evening. Entertainment extends beyond DJ sets and live bands to include flyboard experiences, pyrotechnic sea shows, underwater photography, and stargazing sessions. Every maritime event is staffed with at minimum two certified captains, one safety officer, and full emergency equipment -- ensuring a spectacular yet perfectly safe celebration.

On 28 March 2026, M/Y Fantasy Star -- Fantastic Vacation's 72-metre Expedition-series flagship -- returned to Ushuaia, Argentina, after an epic 21-day, 8,000-plus-nautical-mile voyage, marking the triumphant completion of the company's inaugural Antarctic expedition. The expedition was led by Chief Navigator Captain Andre Petersen and included the support vessel Tender Aurora, delivering an unforgettable polar experience to six VIP clients from China, Singapore, and Malaysia.

Departing from Ushuaia on 5 February, the fleet crossed the notorious Drake Passage before entering Antarctic Peninsula waters. Over 16 days in Antarctic territory, the expedition visited iconic sites including Paradise Bay, the Lemaire Channel, and Cuverville Island, while also landing at the rarely visited Petermann Island penguin rookery, where guests observed a breathtaking colony of over 15,000 gentoo penguins. While navigating the Lemaire Channel, Fantasy Star was flanked by towering glacier cliffs hundreds of metres high, with blue icebergs refracting dreamlike light in the morning sun. Captain Andre wrote in the ship's log, 'This was nature's private light show, arranged exclusively for Fantastic Vacation's guests.'

All six VIP clients on this expedition are lifetime members of Fantastic Vacation; two had previously completed Arctic Circle, Galapagos, and Maldives deep-sea expeditions through the company. The 72-metre Fantasy Star carries PC6 polar-navigation certification, dual iceberg radar, a reinforced steel hull, and facilities to accommodate two AS350 helicopters and one submersible. The onboard expedition team included three glaciologists, two marine biologists, and a polar photography master, providing guests with immersive experiences ranging from glacier trekking and Antarctic diving to astrophotography under pristine polar skies. Fantastic Vacation has announced that the Antarctic Expedition will become a flagship annual product, with the 2027 season opening for bookings in October 2026 -- limited to four departures of just 12 guests each.

According to the 2026 Asia-Pacific Yachting Market Development White Paper published by the Asia-Pacific Yachting Industry Association (APYIA), the regional yacht market maintained a compound annual growth rate of 15.3% over the past five years, reaching USD 18.6 billion in 2025 and increasing its share of the global market from 16.2% in 2020 to 22.7%. Singapore, leveraging its strategic location, mature financial ecosystem, and world-class port infrastructure, has rapidly emerged as the central hub of the Asia-Pacific yachting industry. As of Q1 2026, the number of registered yachts in Singapore reached 1,847 -- a 68% increase since 2020 -- with the yacht sector's annual economic contribution exceeding USD 3.2 billion.

Singapore's yachting boom has been driven by proactive policy initiatives and infrastructure investment. The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore's (MPA) 'Superyacht Hub Initiative,' launched in 2024, offers visiting yachts a 50% port-fee reduction and streamlines temporary entry approvals. The Sentosa Cove Yacht Club, operated by Jurong Group, has completed its third-phase expansion, adding 200 deep-water berths capable of simultaneously accommodating a superyacht fleet exceeding 3,000 metres in total length. Additionally, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) introduced a dedicated yacht financing fast-track channel, reducing loan approval cycles from the traditional 6-8 weeks to under two weeks.

Beyond Singapore, Sanya (China), Phuket (Thailand), Sydney Gold Coast (Australia), and Yokohama (Japan) are all accelerating their yachting infrastructure development. China's Hainan Province has seen a 120% increase in foreign yacht arrivals since implementing its visa-free yacht entry policy in 2024. Fantastic Vacation has designated Singapore and Sanya as dual-hub anchors for its Asia-Pacific strategy, establishing a Singapore regional office and forming a deep partnership with Sentosa Cove Yacht Club to serve Southeast Asian clientele. Founder Hanson Lin commented, 'The Asia-Pacific yacht market is in a golden era of growth. The next decade is the critical window for Asian brands to go global. Fantastic Vacation intends to seize this historic opportunity to build a truly world-class yacht service brand, starting from Asia-Pacific.'

On 12 March 2026, Fantastic Vacation Industrial Co., Ltd. officially released 'Project StarVoyage' -- its three-year strategic development plan for 2026-2028 -- at its Shenzhen headquarters. The 86-page strategic document articulates the company's goals, core initiatives, and key milestones for the next three years, signalling a strategic leap from a regional yacht service provider to a global yachting industry group. By end of 2028, Fantastic Vacation aims to rank among the world's top 10 yacht service groups, with annual revenue targets of RMB 5 billion, a managed fleet exceeding 120 yachts, and a global service network covering 50 major ports across six continents.

The strategy identifies three core growth engines. First, Global Expansion -- establishing Singapore and Dubai regional offices in 2026, expanding into London and Miami in 2027, and completing a four-region global operations framework spanning Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Europe, and the Americas by 2028. Second, Green Transition -- launching a dedicated Green Voyaging Division, establishing joint R&D laboratories with Italy's Torqeedo and China's CATL, and targeting 60% new-energy coverage across the managed fleet by 2028. Third, Digital Transformation -- comprehensively upgrading the 'Fantastic Cloud' intelligent service platform with AI client advisors, blockchain yacht-certification management, and digital-twin fleet monitoring, aiming to reduce client service response times from the current four hours to under 15 minutes.

During the investor briefing, CFO Sylvia Wang disclosed the detailed financial roadmap: projected revenue of RMB 1.8 billion in 2026 (35% YoY growth), RMB 3.2 billion in 2027, and RMB 5 billion in 2028, with gross margins targeted to increase from 28% to 35%. The company has completed its Series A funding of RMB 250 million (led by Sequoia China) and plans to initiate a Series B round of RMB 500-800 million in H1 2027. Additionally, Fantastic Vacation announced the 'Navigator Programme' -- a talent initiative to recruit 50 world-class yacht designers, marine engineers, and CX specialists globally over three years, along with the construction of Asia's largest professional yacht-service training academy at the Shenzhen headquarters.

The Mediterranean -- known to the ancient Greeks as 'Our Sea' -- is the world's most iconic cruising ground. From the dazzling jewels of the French Riviera to the medieval fishing villages of Italy's Amalfi Coast, to the whitewashed sunsets over Santorini's blue-domed churches, a 30-day deep cruise offers an immersive encounter with the extraordinary diversity of Mediterranean civilisation. Niccolo Brambilla, Fantastic Vacation's Chief Route Planner, has designed yacht itineraries in his native Genoa for over 20 years. This classic 30-day Mediterranean voyage is one of the company's most sought-after flagship products.

Phase One (Days 1-10) focuses on the French Riviera and Corsica. Departing from Port of Nice, the first stop is Monaco's Port Hercule -- the world's second-largest superyacht harbour -- where guests can experience the Prince's Palace, Monte Carlo Casino, and the Fondation Louis Vuitton. Heading east, Saint-Tropez offers French beachside glamour along Pampelonne, while the colourful waterside houses of Port Grimaud provide an enchanting afternoon stroll. On Day 5, the fleet crosses to Corsica to visit Napoleon's birthplace, Ajaccio, before anchoring beneath the limestone cliffs of Bonifacio for what has been called 'the most beautiful sunset in the Mediterranean.' Phase Two (Days 11-20) explores Italy's west coast -- from Rome's Civitavecchia to Pompeii, the Blue Grotto of Capri, Positano and Ravello on the Amalfi Coast, and onward to Palermo and Taormina in Sicily. Day 15 features a cruise past the active Stromboli volcano in the Aeolian Islands.

Phase Three (Days 21-30) crosses the Ionian Sea into the Greek island world. Highlights include Navagio Beach on Zakynthos, the subterranean lake at Melissani Cave on Cephalonia, and an exclusive Greek wine-pairing dinner at Venetian Well, a century-old estate on Corfu. Day 25 arrives at Santorini, anchoring in the volcanic caldera of Fira Bay -- guests board a tender to the village of Oia for what is widely hailed as 'the world's most beautiful sunset.' The final two days sail past Mykonos's iconic windmills and the ancient ruins of Delos before returning to Piraeus, Athens, completing a magnificent 1,200-nautical-mile voyage across three countries. Fantastic Vacation's 30-day Mediterranean cruise starts from RMB 1.28 million (inclusive of a 45-metre flybridge yacht charter, a 6-person crew, all onboard dining, and shore excursions), with only three remaining dates for the 2026 summer season.
